scope: Approved current-record forum content authorization; new Java not yet runtime-validated
changes: Article/author body+authorization snapshot from current bound SQL; viewer role/name/status read from current SQL.
Comment detail/list author status/privacy/anonymity comes from current rows, with response whitelist.
Paragraph/notification references do not load cached comments; stale notification target URLs cannot replace current parent links.
Reaction reads and existing parent-lock validation share the current gate; historical revision already reads current SQL and remains unchanged.
limits: SQLite/MySQL use actual query/DTO/reaction services with explicit cache/repository adapters; not whole application IoC.
Normal-comment/notification method bridges are copied verbatim; Markdown rendering, paragraph normalization and legacy URL generation are adapted, not claimed fully revalidated here.
No new production SQL writes, tables or migrations; disposable MySQL removed.
No serializable cross-request/instance consistency claim; permissions are evaluated at read time, not guaranteed unchanged until response receipt.
Requires user IDEA rebuild/restart confirmation before actual HTTP validation.
Existing classic ArticleChannel and forum reaction fanout reuse the shared gate; their prior approved current-permission protection benefits, but classic HTTP handlers were not modified.
